explanation: Program corresponds to recipe: In programming, a program is composed of a series of instructions to achieve specific functions; in cooking, a recipe is a guide that includes operational steps and cooking methods. Both are guidance plans to achieve a goal.

Instructions correspond to operational steps: In programming, instructions refer to commands that perform specific operations in a program; in cooking, operational steps are specific actions to achieve particular cooking effects in a recipe. Both are specific operations in the implementation process.

Programming language corresponds to cooking method: In programming, programming language refers to the syntax and rules used to write a program; in cooking, cooking method refers to the approach to achieve food texture and taste. Both are means and norms to achieve goals.

Compiler corresponds to chef: In programming, a compiler is a tool that translates program code into machine-executable instructions; in cooking, a chef is a person who prepares food according to the recipe and cooking method. Both are executors who convert original information or plans into actual results.

Computer corresponds to kitchen utensils: In programming, a computer is the hardware device that executes program code; in cooking, kitchen utensils are tools used to cook food. Both are auxiliary equipment necessary to achieve the desired goal.

background.source: Programming is the process of creating software applications or computer programs through the use of instructions, known as code. A program or app can be created using a programming language, which is the set of rules, commands, and structures used to create languages that computers can understand. A programmer is someone who writes code to create software application programs, using programming languages to communicate to the computer. A programming language can be translated by a translator, which converts the programming language into machine language that the computer can execute. With Programming, computers can be made to perform tasks that can range from simple calculations to complex problem-solving. Programming skills are essential in the modern world where almost every electronic system, from phones to cars, relies on code to run.
background.target: Cooking is an essential skill that involves the art, science, and craft of using heat to prepare various types of food for consumption. It encompasses multiple cooking techniques and ingredients, and various kitchen utensils to enhance the culinary experience. This age-old activity has evolved throughout time, reflecting local conditions and skills of the cooks. One can cook either at home or professionally, under the guidance of a chef, who has undergone proper training in culinary arts. Each recipe has its own unique cooking method, which may involve grilling, baking, frying, roasting, or boiling, depending on the ingredients used and desired flavor profile. Modern culinary practices have integrated advanced scientific techniques that further enhance the flavor and presentation of dishes. So if you have the right ingredients, kitchen utensils, and follow the appropriate steps, anyone can learn to cook a delicious meal.
